image_description: A street scene featuring a traffic light assembly mounted on a metal pole against an overcast sky. The primary subject is a vertical traffic signal with three circular lenses; the top lens is illuminated red. To the right, a horizontal pedestrian signal displays an orange 'don't walk' hand symbol. Below the signals are green highway direction signs indicating 'I-15' and '91'. Dark tree foliage is visible at the bottom of the frame.
